shapeSummary: 36 mm diameter, 41.6 mm long cylindrical gearbox body with its axis along Z, centered in X and Z (total Z about -32.55 to 32.55) and sitting on Y=0 (axis at Y=18). An 8 mm REX shaft with 7 mm flats extends 23.5 mm from the front face. Front face has four M4 pilot holes (4 mm dia, 10 mm deep) at ±8 mm and two 6 mm deep holes at ±12 mm on the vertical centerline. Rear face has a 13 mm bore and four 3 mm holes on a 25 mm diagonal pattern.
warnings: Front section is modeled as a full 36 mm cylinder; the raised block and clearance cuts are omitted because their shapes are uncertain.
M4 threads are not modeled; the holes are plain 4 mm diameter.
Rear 13 mm bore and 3 mm hole depths are not given; 5 mm blind depth is assumed.
Rear 3 mm hole pattern is read from the 25 mm diagonal, so offsets are ±8.84 mm.
The part axis is Z with the bottom at Y=0, following the analysis JSON; the drawing is ambiguous about orientation.
The shaft flats are on the ±X sides; the flat orientation is assumed.
